reading.title: A Famous Mistake: The Leaning Tower of Pisa
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文讲一个真实的“塞翁失马，焉知非福”：比萨斜塔本是一处建筑缺陷，如今却成了城市最大的收入来源和象征。内容改编自权威媒体 HISTORY 的报道。

source.title: Why does the Leaning Tower of Pisa lean?

passage: Few buildings have turned a defect into a fortune as completely as the Leaning Tower of Pisa. Construction of the white marble bell tower began in 1173, and eight storeys were originally planned. Trouble appeared almost at once. The foundation rested on a treacherous mixture of clay, sand and shells, which settled unevenly, and by the time the third storey was finished the structure had already begun to tilt towards the south. Far from solving the problem, the medieval builders made it worse: the chief engineer, Giovanni di Simone, added extra masonry to the shorter side, but the additional weight only dragged the tower further off vertical.

For centuries the lean was regarded as an embarrassing fault rather than a virtue. By 1990 the tower was leaning roughly 5.5 degrees from perpendicular, its most extreme angle ever recorded, and engineers feared it might eventually collapse. The monument was closed while a delicate rescue was attempted. Rather than propping it up, the engineers cautiously removed soil from beneath the higher side and added counterweights, coaxing the tower back towards upright until the tilt had eased to about four degrees. Yet nobody wanted the famous slant to vanish entirely.

The irony is that the very flaw which once threatened the tower is now its greatest asset. Visitors travel from every continent precisely because the structure refuses to stand straight, posing for photographs that pretend to hold it up. What began as a costly engineering blunder has become an enduring symbol of the city and a dependable source of income, proving that a misfortune can, in time, turn into a genuine blessing in disguise.

questions.question: What is the main point the passage makes about the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
options: It is the oldest bell tower still standing in Italy.
Its construction was finished far ahead of schedule.
A building defect eventually became a valuable advantage.
Medieval engineers deliberately designed it to lean.
questions.explanation_zh: 全文围绕一个核心：斜塔原本是建筑缺陷（defect/flaw），最终却变成城市最大的财富与象征，即“因祸得福”。

questions.question: According to the passage, why did the tower begin to tilt during construction?
options: Its foundation rested on an uneven mixture of clay, sand and shells.
An earthquake shifted the ground beneath the cathedral.
The marble blocks were cut to the wrong size.
Strong winds pushed against the unfinished upper storeys.
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段说地基建在 clay, sand and shells 的混合层上，沉降不均，所以第三层完工时塔身就开始向南倾斜。

questions.question: What happened when Giovanni di Simone added extra masonry to the shorter side?
options: The tower returned almost completely to vertical.
Construction was immediately abandoned for good.
The lean was hidden behind decorative stonework.
The added weight made the tower lean even more.
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段说他往较矮的一侧加砌石料想补救，但额外的重量反而把塔拉得更偏离垂直，使倾斜加剧。

questions.question: What can we infer about the engineers' goal during the 1990 rescue work?
options: They wanted to demolish the tower and rebuild it straight.
They aimed to make it safer without removing its famous lean.
They hoped to increase the lean to attract more tourists.
They intended to close the monument permanently.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中说他们把倾斜减到约四度，但“没有人希望这著名的倾斜彻底消失”，可推断目标是让塔更安全又保留招牌式的倾斜。

questions.question: In the first paragraph, the word "treacherous" describing the mixture of clay, sand and shells most nearly means
options: richly decorated.
perfectly level.
dangerously unreliable.
extremely expensive.
questions.explanation_zh: treacherous 在这里形容地基材料“暗藏危险、不可靠”，正因为它沉降不均才导致塔身倾斜，所以最接近 dangerously unreliable。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 58 的传言与反差句式，并把语境提升到 B2+：用 is said to possess 报道传闻，用 Because..., the number of...has increased 写传播后的结果，用 It is said that if... 写条件传言，用 has pointed out that... 给出冷静而现实的理由，最后用 So far, not one of them has... 用证据反衬传言。

patterns.title: is said to possess ...
patterns.source: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
patterns.focus_zh: is said to possess 用来报道传闻，意思是“据说拥有”，并不等于说话人已经证明它是真的。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一座城市、博物馆或古老建筑据说拥有某个奇特之物，并暗示它如何吸引外界注意。
patterns.sample: The ancient cathedral city is said to possess a crooked tower that paradoxically attracts millions of curious visitors every single year.
patterns.tip_zh: 主语可换成 a city、a museum、an old building；possess 后接它据说拥有的稀奇之物，再补一句说明它带来的影响。

patterns.title: Because ..., the number of ... has increased
patterns.source: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors has now increased.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式把原因和现在的结果连起来：因为某件事被传播，所以某个数量已经增加。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一处地方因为某个缺陷、争议或报道被广泛关注后，游客、读者或顾客的数量随之上升。
patterns.sample: Because the famous structural flaw was featured in a documentary, the number of tourists booking guided tours has increased sharply.
patterns.tip_zh: Because 后写传播或报道的原因；the number of 后接复数名词，但谓语仍用单数 has increased。

patterns.title: It is said that if ..., ...
patterns.source: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.
patterns.focus_zh: It is said that if... 用来写“据说如果……就会……”，适合表达未经证明的条件传言。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个流传已久却无人证实的条件传言，语气要像在转述坊间说法，而非陈述事实。
patterns.sample: It is said that if any traveller climbs the tilting tower at midnight, he will be granted a single secret wish.
patterns.tip_zh: if 从句写条件，主句写传言里的“后果”；保持转述语气，不要写成已被证实的事实。

patterns.title: has pointed out that ...
patterns.source: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income.
patterns.focus_zh: has pointed out that 表示“已经指出”，常用来在恐慌或误解之中给出冷静、现实的理由。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某位专家、官员或管理者指出一个曾被视为缺点的特征其实带来了关注、声望或收入。
patterns.sample: The city's chief engineer has pointed out that the very defect once thought shameful is now its most profitable attraction.
patterns.tip_zh: that 后接完整句子；理由要具体，比如 brings worldwide attention 或 is a source of income。

patterns.title: So far, not one of them has ...
patterns.source: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death.
patterns.focus_zh: So far, not one of them has... 用现在完成时写“到目前为止没有一个人……”，用证据反衬传言。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写很多人听过某个夸张传言并亲自前往验证，但到目前为止没有一个人遇到传言所说的结果。
must_include: So far, not one of them has
patterns.sample: Thousands of sceptical tourists have leaned against the famous tower to test the legend, yet so far, not one of them has come to any harm.
patterns.tip_zh: So far 后常接现在完成时；用它陈述目前的证据，不要再把传言本身夸大。
